schema:
CREATE TABLE model_usage (day TEXT NOT NULL, model_id TEXT NOT NULL, provider_id TEXT NOT NULL, api_model TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL, calls INTEGER NOT NULL, input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, duration_ms REAL NOT NULL, priced_calls INTEGER NOT NULL, estimated_usd REAL NOT NULL, reported_input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, reported_output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, reported_usage_calls INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cache_rate_input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cache_rate_read_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cache_rate_known_calls INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ordinary_input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cache_read_input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cache_write_input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cache_write_5m_input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cache_write_1h_input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cache_write_30m_input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cache_write_12h_input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cache_known_calls INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cache_read_known_calls INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cache_write_known_calls INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, partial_priced_calls INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, legacy_calls INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, unknown_usage_calls INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ordinary_input_usd REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, output_usd REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cache_read_usd REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cache_write_usd REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, legacy_estimated_usd REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(day,model_id,provider_id,api_model,role));
CREATE TABLE model_usage_events(
  day TEXT,
  model_id TEXT,
  provider_id TEXT,
  api_model TEXT,
  role TEXT,
  calls INT,
  input_tokens INT,
  output_tokens INT,
  duration_ms REAL,
  priced_calls INT,
  estimated_usd REAL,
  reported_input_tokens INT,
  reported_output_tokens INT,
  reported_usage_calls INT,
  cache_rate_input_tokens INT,
  cache_rate_read_tokens INT,
  cache_rate_known_calls INT,
  ordinary_input_tokens INT,
  cache_read_input_tokens INT,
  cache_write_input_tokens INT,
  cache_write_5m_input_tokens INT,
  cache_write_1h_input_tokens INT,
  cache_write_30m_input_tokens INT,
  cache_write_12h_input_tokens INT,
  cache_known_calls INT,
  cache_read_known_calls INT,
  cache_write_known_calls INT,
  partial_priced_calls INT,
  legacy_calls INT,
  unknown_usage_calls INT,
  ordinary_input_usd REAL,
  output_usd REAL,
  cache_read_usd REAL,
  cache_write_usd REAL,
  legacy_estimated_usd REAL,
  at
);
CREATE TABLE model_usage_history(
  day TEXT,
  model_id TEXT,
  provider_id TEXT,
  api_model TEXT,
  role TEXT,
  calls INT,
  input_tokens INT,
  output_tokens INT,
  duration_ms REAL,
  priced_calls INT,
  estimated_usd REAL,
  reported_input_tokens INT,
  reported_output_tokens INT,
  reported_usage_calls INT,
  cache_rate_input_tokens INT,
  cache_rate_read_tokens INT,
  cache_rate_known_calls INT,
  ordinary_input_tokens INT,
  cache_read_input_tokens INT,
  cache_write_input_tokens INT,
  cache_write_5m_input_tokens INT,
  cache_write_1h_input_tokens INT,
  cache_write_30m_input_tokens INT,
  cache_write_12h_input_tokens INT,
  cache_known_calls INT,
  cache_read_known_calls INT,
  cache_write_known_calls INT,
  partial_priced_calls INT,
  legacy_calls INT,
  unknown_usage_calls INT,
  ordinary_input_usd REAL,
  output_usd REAL,
  cache_read_usd REAL,
  cache_write_usd REAL,
  legacy_estimated_usd REAL
);
